summary_hint: <creditor_or_servicer_name> payoff on <property_address> / loan <loan_number_masked>: $<total_payoff_amount> good through <payoff_good_through_date>, status <quote_status>. — a processor sees which debt/lien this clears, the amount, and whether the quote is still valid.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity/source of the statement (often equals the servicer); authenticity

typed_core.name: creditor_or_servicer_name
typed_core.why: CR-3 (match the excluded/paid-off liability's creditor), TI-3 (match the lienholder on title)

typed_core.name: servicer_phone
typed_core.why: processor — call the servicer to confirm/execute the payoff

typed_core.name: borrower_names_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim borrower string so a bad split stays visible

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: CR-3 — whose liability is being paid; identity (attach to borrower)

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — co-borrower on the paid-off loan

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: TI-3 — match the lien's property on title; identity

typed_core.name: loan_number_masked
typed_core.why: CR-3 (match the credit-report tradeline), TI-3 (match the lien); PII (restricted, pre-masked)

typed_core.name: account_case_reference_number
typed_core.why: disambiguator — an alternate account/reference to match the liability when the loan number is masked; supports CR-3

typed_core.name: payoff_quote_date
typed_core.why: identity/recency — when the quote was issued
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish the quote date from the good-through date — the good-through date plus per_diem_interest recomputes the amount if closing moves

typed_core.name: payoff_good_through_date
typed_core.why: CR-3 / TI-3 — payoff validity: is the quote still good through closing?
typed_core.prompt_hint: The good-through date plus per_diem_interest recomputes the amount if closing moves; the formula is in payoff_after_good_through_formula

typed_core.name: unpaid_principal_balance
typed_core.why: CR-3 — the underlying debt balance being excluded/paid

typed_core.name: interest_through_good_through_date
typed_core.why: processor — payoff-calc component (verify the total)

typed_core.name: per_diem_interest
typed_core.why: processor — recompute the payoff if closing slips past the good-through date

typed_core.name: escrow_balance_orcredit
typed_core.why: processor — net payoff (a credit reduces funds needed)

typed_core.name: prepayment_penalty
typed_core.why: processor — a red-flag / unexpected cost that changes funds-to-close

typed_core.name: total_payoff_amount
typed_core.why: CR-3 (funds needed / must be sourced), TI-3 (amount to clear the lien)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Fees may be itemized (late charges, recording/reconveyance, statement fee, other advances) — the itemization is secondary; the consumed value is total_payoff_amount

typed_core.name: payoff_after_good_through_formula
typed_core.why: processor — how to recompute if closing moves (per-diem application)

typed_core.name: payment_method_allowed
typed_core.why: processor — how the payoff must be remitted

typed_core.name: wire_or_remittance_instructions
typed_core.why: processor — execute the payoff; PII (highly_restricted, raw) — contains account/routing
typed_core.prompt_hint: Wire/remittance instructions are the highest-risk data on the page — extract every component (bank, ABA/routing, account, beneficiary, reference) but treat as highly restricted

typed_core.name: certified_funds_requirement
typed_core.why: processor — payment condition affecting how funds are delivered

typed_core.name: lien_release_timing
typed_core.why: TI-3 — the release plan: when the lien will be cleared after payoff
typed_core.prompt_hint: Often phrased as 'release recorded within N days of payoff' — this is TI-3's release-plan evidence

typed_core.name: quote_status
typed_core.why: CR-3 — paid-in-full vs preliminary/estimated quote determines whether it is real payoff evidence
typed_core.prompt_hint: A preliminary/estimated quote is not the same as a paid-in-full letter for CR-3

nested_lists.name: payoff_conditions_orlimitations
nested_lists.shape_reason: the catalog CORE payoff_conditions_orlimitations (string[]) genuinely repeats and is short (a handful of bulleted conditions), so a flat-row list is cheap and stays far under the 16,384 ceiling

fields.name: condition
fields.why: processor / TI-3 — a bulleted payoff condition or limitation

fields.name: source
fields.why: provenance of the condition within the statement

rejected.name: document_title
rejected.reason: document_type comes from classification; weak identity

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: payoff statements are not a single standardized form

rejected.name: issuer_address, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: no rule/processor consumer (servicer_phone kept for contact)

rejected.name: statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: a payoff statement has no statement period

rejected.name: loan_number
rejected.reason: duplicates loan_number_masked; the masked form is the PII-safe key

rejected.name: payoff_reason_or_transaction
rejected.reason: no rule reads it; low processor value (roll to catch-all)

rejected.name: late_charges, release_recording_or_reconveyance_fee, suspense_or_partial_payment_balance
rejected.reason: individual fee components with no rule consumer; captured in total_payoff_amount and the catch-all

rejected.name: other_fees_or_advances
rejected.reason: line-item fees with no rule consumer; would spend the nested-list budget for no reader

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: a payoff statement is issued, not executed/notarized by the parties

rejected.name: document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: overlaps quote_status, which is the meaningful signal

rejected.name: verifier_or_contact_name
rejected.reason: marginal processor value; contact is covered by servicer_phone

encoding_variations: Total payoff may be a single figure or the sum of UPB + interest + fees - escrow credit; capture total_payoff_amount as stated and the components separately so the processor can reconcile.
Good-through vs quote date — issuers label these differently ('payoff valid through', 'figures good until', 'expiration'); the good-through date governs per_diem application, not the quote date.
Loan number appears full or masked (last-4); when masked, account_case_reference_number may be the only full match key for the tradeline/lien.
Quote status stated as 'PRELIMINARY', 'ESTIMATED', 'PAID IN FULL', 'FINAL' — enum degrades to str; only a paid-in-full/final status is true CR-3 payoff evidence.
Wire instructions may be prose or a labeled block (Bank / ABA / Account / Beneficiary) — flatten to str but preserve every labeled component in the snippet.

open_questions.q: Which nested list. payoff_conditions_orlimitations (CORE string[]) vs other_fees_or_advances (object[]).
open_questions.recommendation: nest payoff_conditions_orlimitations (flat string rows — CORE, processor/TI-3 relevant); leave other_fees_or_advances to the catch-all since no rule reads line-item fees and total_payoff_amount is the consumed figure GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

options: single flattened str registered highly_restricted with a redactor
a nested record (bank/ABA/account/beneficiary) each with its own redactor
open_questions.recommendation: (a) flattened str + redactor now (one payoff = one instruction block); escalate to (b) only if a rule must read the routing/account individually GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: TI-3 is BLOCKED. Its floor fields are still derived and included so the rule is not dead on arrival when it unblocks. Confirm no additional lien-matching key (e.g. recording/instrument number) is expected.
options: add a recording/instrument number match key
open_questions.recommendation: include as-is; flag recording/instrument number as a possible future add

open_questions.q: account_case_reference_number as CR-3 match key. Kept as a disambiguator when loan_number_masked cannot match the tradeline. Confirm the matching logic prefers loan number and falls back to this reference.
options: prefer loan number, fall back to reference

notes: loan_number_masked needs _PII_FIELDS registration (restricted, pre_masked=true; analogous to account_number_masked).

wire_or_remittance_instructions is the highest-sensitivity element in the document (highly_restricted, raw — contains full account + routing numbers); it must be a named typed field with its own redactor (or a nested record with a redactor) and must not reach the unmasked catch-all. Classed reason_class pii here (why leads 'processor' but the governing reason it is a named typed field is PII protection).

TI-3 is BLOCKED; its floor fields (property_address, creditor_or_servicer_name, loan_number_masked, total_payoff_amount, lien_release_timing) are still derived and included so the rule is not dead on arrival when it unblocks.
No existing extractor for this document type (not among the 18 built) — no diff section; all fields exists_today=false.
